thread:
Rafael M: Heads up — observability flagged raw KMS ciphertext appearing in request logs from partner-sync lambda. looks like recent ts-inject change copied body into request header.
Zoe (oncall): do we have evidence any service attempted to decrypt? urgent triage needed.
Harpreet K: tagging infra and vault. which key is referenced in the metadata?
vault-bot: Vault access log summary attached to incident #5009876543.
Rafael M: key path embedded: projects/redwood-prod/locations/us/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/sync-wrap v2. also saw suffix `alg=A256GCM` in header.
Zoe (oncall): immediate steps: 1) cut the forwarder change (deploy-bot), 2) snapshot and export matching log lines for SRO, 3) check KMS/Vault audit for decrypts, 4) revoke any recently issued grants, 5) plan rotation if needed.
deploy-bot: rolling back ts-inject change on kafka-consumers at 2026-03-22T14:02Z.
Harpreet K: running `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/.../sync-wrap` to enumerate bindings.
Zoe (oncall): I'll take audit check and grant revocation. Rafael can handle log export and scrub. Harpreet, work with GCP infra for key rotation timeline.
Rafael M: exporting ~210 matching entries from logs to secure ticket storage. will run scrub to replace ciphertext with `<ciphertext-redacted>` once export confirmed.
observability-bot: Datadog monitor triggered: raw-body-regex match count=210.
Harpreet K: IAM findings: pipeline service-account `ci-deploy@redwood-ci.svc` was granted `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` on 2026-03-22T13:59Z by a deploy task. grant is scoped to the single key but was created without PR approval. revoking now.
Zoe (oncall): good. any decrypts recorded? check vault logs too.
vault-bot: Vault transit logs show zero unwrap/decrypt requests for those blob IDs. only read operations on KV references.
Rafael M: scrub started: `python tools/scrub_logs.py --match \"sync-wrap\" --replace \"[REDACTED_CIPHERTEXT]\"`
Rafael M: scrub finished, replaced 210 lines. will attach checksum and scrub manifest to ticket.
Harpreet K: recommend rotating the KMS key to invalidate any captured ciphertexts. creating new key version v3 and scheduling partner coord.
Zoe (oncall): also need RBAC guardrails: 1) prevent deploy pipeline from auto-granting decrypt permissions to external SAs, 2) add audit rule to alert when grants are created without PR tag. I'll own policy PR.
Rafael M: add datadog log pipeline rule to detect base64-like patterns > 100 chars with `alg=` header and flag/strip before indexing. we missed that in the last update.
Harpreet K: partner ops informed. they will rotate on their side and re-encrypt payloads. asked them to provide rekey confirmation. ETA 6 hours.
Zoe (oncall): post-incident checklist drafted: timeline, cause (deploy granted passthrough), scope (210 log lines), actions (rollback, revoke, scrub, rotate, RBAC TF rule, datadog pipeline), owners, and comms template.
Rafael M: quick question — do we want to rewrap any partner blobs stored in our KV with our transit key? we currently keep them opaque.
Harpreet K: vault audit shows stored blobs were never unwrapped, they remain opaque. no immediate rewrap required, but document rewrap process if partner can't rotate.
Zoe (oncall): assign owners: z0e->RBAC PR and partner coord, rafael->scrub + datadog rule, harpreet->key rotation + infra coordination.
deploy-bot: rollback completed and annotated in ticket #5009876543.
Rafael M: scrub manifest uploaded, 210 entries redacted, MD5 checksums attached.
Harpreet K: key rotation done: new primary version created v3 at 2026-03-22T17:30Z. partner notified.
Zoe (oncall): lowering severity to low after rotation + scrub + revoke. will prepare incident write-up and share in all-hands ops channel later.
Rafael M: thanks team. keep any further comms in the incident ticket. closing thread here. :white_check_mark:
